# Magami NTD

> Magami NTD is a public, cited knowledge graph of neglected tropical diseases — one page for every disease, pathogen, vector, treatment, diagnostic, target, technology, trial, institution, roadmap, bottleneck and idea, with a plain-English TL;DR on every page.

Magami NTD is a project of Magami Open Sciences Initiative (https://magamios.org). It is 476 linked
objects across 16 kinds, generated from an open corpus. Every object has a plain-English
TL;DR, a longer summary, the date it was last checked, and at least one primary source.

Work in progress: content is being built and checked in the open and may be incomplete, out of date
or wrong. Verify anything that matters at its primary source. Nothing here is medical advice.

## Machine-readable access
- Full corpus digest: https://ntd.magamios.org/llms-full.txt
- JSON API index: https://ntd.magamios.org/api/v1/index.json
- Per-kind lists: https://ntd.magamios.org/api/v1/<kind>.json
- Per-object records: https://ntd.magamios.org/api/v1/<kind>/<id>.json

## Kinds
- Diseases (26): https://ntd.magamios.org/diseases/ — Every neglected tropical disease the WHO names, with what causes it, who it strikes, and what can be done.
- Pathogens (25): https://ntd.magamios.org/pathogens/ — The parasites, worms, bacteria, viruses, fungi and venoms behind the diseases.
- Vectors (9): https://ntd.magamios.org/vectors/ — The mosquitoes, flies, snails, bugs and mites that carry disease — and how to control them.
- Treatments (52): https://ntd.magamios.org/drugs/ — Medicines that cure or control NTDs, from decades-old essential medicines to candidates in trials.
- Diagnostics (26): https://ntd.magamios.org/diagnostics/ — How an infection is confirmed: from a stool smear under a microscope to a blood test that decides treatment.
- Targets (45): https://ntd.magamios.org/targets/ — The molecules in a parasite a drug can switch off, and why they are hard or easy to drug.
- Technologies (46): https://ntd.magamios.org/technologies/ — The tools that fight NTDs: vector control, vaccines, diagnostics, drug discovery and AI.
- Trials (39): https://ntd.magamios.org/trials/ — Landmark and current studies, with results stated in plain terms.
- Institutions (49): https://ntd.magamios.org/institutions/ — The institutes, agencies, funders and product-development partnerships doing the work.
- Countries (27): https://ntd.magamios.org/countries/ — Where the burden is, what has been eliminated, and how the programmes are run.
- People (34): https://ntd.magamios.org/people/ — The people whose work this corpus records — historical discoverers and the contemporary field.
- Roadmaps (7): https://ntd.magamios.org/roadmaps/ — History to horizon for each family of technology, step by step.
- Guidelines (22): https://ntd.magamios.org/guidelines/ — The recommendations that set what programmes actually do — and what changed when they were updated.
- Bottlenecks (17): https://ntd.magamios.org/bottlenecks/ — The constraints slowing progress, and what would unlock them.
- Ideas (12): https://ntd.magamios.org/ideas/ — Hypotheses and fixes, each with a proposed test.
- Glossary (40): https://ntd.magamios.org/terms/ — Plain-English definitions of the words this field uses.
